people.name: Amon
people.line: King of Judah, son of Manasseh

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: King of Judah, son of Hezekiah.

people.name: Uzza
people.line: A garden where Manasseh and Amon were buried

translations.web: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And Manasseh rested with his fathers and was buried in his palace garden, the garden of Uzza. And his son Amon reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
